title: Claim and Citation Evidence Verifier
tagline: A citation can be real, relevant, and still fail to support the sentence beside it.

cards: Resolved links create the appearance of a verified report.
The cited passage may discuss the topic while never supporting the actual claim.
A false sentence inherits authority from a real source.
Every material assertion stays traceable through human publication.

story.headline: The citation that exists but proves nothing
beats: A report arrives with a polished bibliography and working links.
One source covers the same topic but never states the drafted conclusion.
The agent treats relevance and authority as entailment.
The ledger holds publication and routes the exact unsupported claim.
